text:
If today feels heavy, "NOTE TO SELF" album might sit with you for a bit.
https://danyeloz.bandcamp.com/album/note-to-self.

Ever have one moment, one post, one realization that changes the way you see yourself and the people around you?

“Note to Self” is a song I wrote from that exact feeling.

"Ursula" comes out in 6 days.

What if the person you should have chosen was standing right in front of you?

Pre-order on Bandcamp. #NewMusic
https://danyeloz.bandcamp.com/track/ursula-2
